note: Check catalogue as data. Level P0 is only allowed when every source is verified and the rule is not an experience item (p0_ok). Text is paraphrased; see the spec source table for originals.

S6.name: GOV.UK online and distance selling for businesses

S6b.name: GOV.UK accepting returns and giving refunds

S11.name: Shopify Help international SEO for markets

S12.name: FTC Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule (16 CFR 435)

S13.name: Ontario Consumer Protection Act 2002, O. Reg. 17/05

rules.zh: 找不到退货退款政策, 或页脚点不到
rules.en: No return/refund policy, or it is not linked from the footer
rules.fix_zh: 后台 设置 → 政策 填写退货退款政策, 并加到页脚菜单
rules.fix_en: Fill in the refund policy (Settings > Policies) and add it to the footer menu

rules.zh: 找不到运费政策 (含配送范围)
rules.en: No shipping policy (incl. where you ship)
rules.fix_zh: 填写运费政策, 写清发哪些国家, 并加到页脚
rules.fix_en: Add a shipping policy listing the countries you ship to, linked from the footer

rules.zh: 找不到隐私政策
rules.en: No privacy policy
rules.fix_zh: 用平台模板起步, 再按隐私检查项补全
rules.fix_en: Start from the platform template, then complete it per the privacy items

rules.zh: 找不到服务条款
rules.en: No terms of service
rules.fix_zh: 用平台模板生成服务条款并改成你的信息
rules.fix_en: Generate terms of service from the template and edit in your details

rules.zh: 找不到联系方式 (表单, 邮箱, 电话或社媒都没有)
rules.en: No contact method found (no form, email, phone or social link)
rules.fix_zh: 加"联系我们"页并放进页脚
rules.fix_en: Add a Contact us page and link it from the footer

rules.zh: 面向德国: 找不到 Impressum (法律声明) 页, 或页脚不能一步点到, 或缺名称/地址/邮箱
rules.en: Selling to Germany: no Impressum (legal notice) page one click from the footer, or it lacks name/address/email
rules.fix_zh: 用平台的"法律声明"政策写公司名, 可送达地址, 联系方式, 放页脚并命名 Impressum
rules.fix_en: Use the Legal notice policy for company name, postal address and contact, link it in the footer as Impressum

rules.zh: 政策正文太短 (少于 200 字符) 或仍有模板占位文字
rules.en: Policy text is very short (under 200 characters) or still has template placeholders
rules.fix_zh: 把模板里的方括号内容换成你的真实信息
rules.fix_en: Replace the bracketed template text with your real details

rules.zh: 有订阅/循环扣费商品, 但没有订阅政策
rules.en: Subscription products but no subscription policy
rules.fix_zh: 写清扣费周期, 金额, 如何取消
rules.fix_en: State billing cycle, amount and how to cancel

rules.zh: 退货政策缺少以下内容 (退货期, 起算点, 商品条件, 怎么发起, 退款时长, 是否接受退货)
rules.en: Return policy is missing items (window, start date, condition, how to start, refund time, whether returns are accepted)
rules.fix_zh: 按缺项逐项补一句
rules.fix_en: Add one sentence per missing item

rules.zh: 退货期写成从下单/购买日起算
rules.en: Return window counted from the order/purchase date
rules.fix_zh: 改成"从签收日起算"
rules.fix_en: Count it from the delivery date

rules.zh: 运费政策缺少以下内容 (处理时长, 运输时长, 运费或包邮门槛, 追踪号)
rules.en: Shipping policy is missing items (processing time, transit time, rates or free-shipping threshold, tracking)
rules.fix_zh: 时长写区间, 按实际物流写, 不写做不到的
rules.fix_en: Give time ranges based on your real carrier, never promise faster

rules.zh: 政策写了退货运费或补货费, 但商品页看不到
rules.en: Policy mentions return shipping or restocking fees that product pages do not show
rules.fix_zh: 在商品页"运费与退货"处也写清, 或取消该费用
rules.fix_en: Show the fee on product pages too, or drop it

rules.zh: 面向欧盟/英国: 对无理由退货收补货费
rules.en: EU/UK: restocking fee on change-of-mind returns
rules.fix_zh: 建议取消补货费, 或只针对超出正常检查造成的损坏
rules.fix_en: Drop the restocking fee or limit it to damage beyond normal handling

rules.zh: 出现"概不退换/All sales final/No refunds", 且没写质量问题除外
rules.en: "All sales final" / "No refunds" without an exception for faulty goods
rules.fix_zh: 改成"不接受无理由退货, 质量问题按法律处理"
rules.fix_en: Say change-of-mind returns are not accepted but faulty goods are handled as the law requires

rules.zh: 退货地址在中国大陆, 但没写退货运费谁付
rules.en: Return address is in mainland China but who pays return shipping is not stated
rules.fix_zh: 写清寄回地址所在国与费用承担方; 考虑海外退货仓
rules.fix_en: State the return country and who pays; consider a local returns address

rules.zh: 退货天数前后说法不一致
rules.en: Return window differs between pages
rules.fix_zh: 定一个数, 全站统一 (公告栏, 商品页, 常见问题, 政策)
rules.fix_en: Pick one number and use it everywhere (banner, product pages, FAQ, policy)

rules.zh: 发货/送达时长前后说法不一致
rules.en: Shipping/delivery time differs between pages
rules.fix_zh: 按最慢的真实时长统一
rules.fix_en: Use the slowest real time everywhere

rules.zh: 退货运费谁付前后说法不一致
rules.en: Who pays return shipping differs between pages
rules.fix_zh: 统一, 并说明适用范围
rules.fix_en: Make it consistent and say when it applies

rules.zh: 包邮门槛前后说法不一致
rules.en: Free-shipping threshold differs between pages
rules.fix_zh: 统一金额与币种
rules.fix_en: Use one amount and currency

rules.zh: 补货费一处有, 一处没有
rules.en: Restocking fee mentioned in one place, denied in another
rules.fix_zh: 统一或取消
rules.fix_en: Make it consistent or drop it

rules.zh: 政策/常见问题里的币种与站点币种不一致
rules.en: Currency in policy/FAQ differs from the store currency
rules.fix_zh: 金额写币种代码 (USD/EUR), 多市场时写"按结账页币种"
rules.fix_en: Write currency codes (USD/EUR); for several markets say amounts follow checkout currency

rules.zh: 退款到账时长前后说法不一致
rules.en: Refund timing differs between pages
rules.fix_zh: 统一; 面向欧盟/英国不超过 14 天
rules.fix_en: Make it consistent; for EU/UK no more than 14 days

rules.zh: 公司名/邮箱在不同页面写的不一样
rules.en: Business name/email differs between pages
rules.fix_zh: 统一为实际签约主体
rules.fix_en: Use your real legal entity everywhere

rules.zh: 网站上看不到清楚的联系方式
rules.en: No clearly visible contact details
rules.fix_zh: 页脚放邮箱或联系页链接
rules.fix_en: Put an email or contact link in the footer

rules.zh: 不是全站加密访问 (http 没有跳到 https)
rules.en: Not fully HTTPS (http does not redirect to https)
rules.fix_zh: 后台域名设置开启 SSL
rules.fix_en: Turn on SSL in the domain settings

rules.zh: 商品页看不到税费/运费说明
rules.en: Product pages do not mention tax/shipping
rules.fix_zh: 主题设置里打开"含税""结账时计算运费"提示
rules.fix_en: Enable the tax/shipping notice in theme settings

rules.zh: 页面语言与目标市场语言不一致
rules.en: Page language does not match the target market
rules.fix_zh: 给该市场开翻译, 或不在该国投放
rules.fix_en: Translate for that market, or do not advertise there

rules.zh: 抽样商品不能加购 (没有加购按钮或全部售罄)
rules.en: Sampled products cannot be added to cart (no button or sold out)
rules.fix_zh: 售罄商品下架或从投放中排除
rules.fix_en: Unpublish sold-out items or exclude them from ads

rules.zh: 找不到经营地址
rules.en: No business address found
rules.fix_zh: 写真实经营地址; 发货地如实写"从中国发货"
rules.fix_en: Show a real business address; say honestly where orders ship from

rules.zh: 有订阅/定期扣费, 商品页没写清周期与金额
rules.en: Subscription without clear billing cycle and amount on the product page
rules.fix_zh: 商品页写"每 30 天扣 $X, 随时取消"
rules.fix_en: Say e.g. "$X every 30 days, cancel anytime" on the product page

rules.zh: 退货信息 (天数, 运费) 前后不一致, 谷歌商家中心也没法填对
rules.en: Return details conflict, so Merchant Center settings cannot match
rules.fix_zh: 先统一退货说法, 再在谷歌商家中心填同样的退货设置
rules.fix_en: Fix the conflicting return wording first, then enter the same return settings in Merchant Center

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 没写 14 天无理由撤回 (从收货日起算)
rules.en: EU: no 14-day right of withdrawal counted from delivery
rules.fix_zh: 加一段"撤回权"说明: 收货后 14 天内可无理由撤回
rules.fix_en: Add a right-of-withdrawal section: 14 days from delivery, no reason needed

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 没有撤回说明或示范撤回表
rules.en: EU: no withdrawal instructions or model withdrawal form
rules.fix_zh: 附上欧盟示范撤回表 (可下载或正文)
rules.fix_en: Add the EU model withdrawal form

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 退款时长超过 14 天或没写
rules.en: EU: refund time over 14 days or not stated
rules.fix_zh: 写"收到撤回通知 14 天内退款" (可等收到退货再退)
rules.fix_en: Say refunds are made within 14 days of the withdrawal notice (may wait for the goods)

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 没写退货运费由谁承担
rules.en: EU: does not say who pays return shipping
rules.fix_zh: 明写"退货运费由买家承担"或"由我们承担"
rules.fix_en: State who pays return shipping

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 仍链接已关闭的欧盟在线纠纷平台 (ODR)
rules.en: EU: still links the closed EU ODR platform
rules.fix_zh: 删掉该链接与句子 (平台已于 2025 年关闭)
rules.fix_en: Remove the link and sentence (the platform closed in 2025)

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 页面有划线价/折扣, 原价须为前 30 天最低价, 前台无法核对
rules.en: EU: strike-through prices shown; the prior price must be the 30-day lowest, cannot be verified from the storefront
rules.fix_zh: 核对后台 30 天价格记录
rules.fix_en: Check your 30-day price history in the admin

rules.zh: 面向欧盟: 商品页没有制造商/欧盟负责人信息
rules.en: EU: product pages lack manufacturer / EU responsible person details
rules.fix_zh: 在商品页"产品安全信息"区写清制造商名称, 地址, 邮箱; 中国工厂需指定欧盟负责人
rules.fix_en: Add a product safety section with manufacturer name, address, email and EU responsible person

rules.zh: 面向德国: Impressum 与其他页面的主体信息不一致
rules.en: Germany: Impressum details differ from other pages
rules.fix_zh: 统一 Impressum, 联系页, 政策里的主体信息
rules.fix_en: Use the same entity details in the Impressum, contact page and policies

rules.zh: 面向英国: 没写 14 天取消权 (收货起算, 不需理由)
rules.en: UK: no 14-day cancellation right from delivery
rules.fix_zh: 加"取消权"段落; 不告知时买家可在 12 个月内取消
rules.fix_en: Add a cancellation-rights section; without it buyers may cancel for up to 12 months

rules.zh: 面向英国: 没写 14 天内退款并退还标准运费
rules.en: UK: does not say refunds within 14 days incl. standard delivery
rules.fix_zh: 政策写明 14 天内退款, 含标准运费
rules.fix_en: State refunds within 14 days, including standard delivery

rules.zh: 面向加拿大 (安大略): 网购需披露的信息不齐 (电话, 地址, 币种, 退换条件等)
rules.en: Canada (Ontario): required online-sale disclosures incomplete (phone, address, currency, refund terms)
rules.fix_zh: 联系页与政策补齐电话, 地址, 币种和退换条件
rules.fix_en: Add phone, address, currency and refund terms

rules.zh: 面向澳洲: 写了一律不退或只退未拆封, 没写质量问题除外
rules.en: Australia: blanket no-refund or unopened-only terms without a faulty-goods exception
rules.fix_zh: 改为"无理由退货需未拆封; 质量问题不受此限"
rules.fix_en: Say change-of-mind returns need unopened items, but faulty goods are always covered

rules.zh: 面向美国: 没写发货时长 (默认按 30 天内发货要求)
rules.en: US: no shipping time stated (the 30-day default applies)
rules.fix_zh: 发货时长写真实区间, 备好延误通知模板
rules.fix_en: State a real shipping range and prepare a delay notice

rules.zh: 隐私政策缺少以下内容 (主体与联系方式, 用途, 分享给谁, 保存期限, 用户权利等)
rules.en: Privacy policy is missing items (controller and contact, purposes, recipients, retention, user rights)
rules.fix_zh: 按缺项逐条补
rules.fix_en: Add each missing item

rules.zh: 有广告追踪代码: 加州隐私法达到门槛时需要"不出售或共享我的个人信息"链接
rules.en: Ad pixels present: California privacy law may require a "Do Not Sell or Share" link if you meet its thresholds
rules.fix_zh: 先判断是否达到门槛 (年收入 2500 万美元等), 多数新店不适用
rules.fix_en: Check the thresholds first (e.g. USD 25M revenue); most new stores are below them

rules.zh: 面向欧盟/英国: 有追踪代码, 但看不到 Cookie 同意组件的迹象
rules.en: EU/UK: tracking code present but no sign of a cookie consent tool
rules.fix_zh: 打开平台自带的 Cookie 横幅, 设为同意前不加载营销 Cookie
rules.fix_en: Enable the platform cookie banner and block marketing cookies until consent

rules.zh: 同意前是否已加载营销 Cookie (需要浏览器实测)
rules.en: Whether marketing cookies load before consent (needs a browser test)
rules.fix_zh: 用浏览器无痕窗口打开首页, 不点同意, 看开发者工具里是否已有广告请求; 或用 Pro 版实测
rules.fix_en: Open the homepage in a private window without consenting and check for ad requests; or use Pro

rules.zh: 主体名称在政策, 联系页, 页脚写的不一样
rules.en: Business name differs between policies, contact page and footer
rules.fix_zh: 统一为实际签约主体
rules.fix_en: Use one legal entity name everywhere

rules.zh: 联系邮箱是免费邮箱 (gmail/qq/163 等)
rules.en: Contact email is a free mailbox (gmail, qq, 163 ...)
rules.fix_zh: 用店铺域名邮箱 (更可信, 也利于发信)
rules.fix_en: Use an email on your store domain

rules.zh: 残留模板信息 (example.com, 演示电话或地址)
rules.en: Template leftovers (example.com, demo phone or address)
rules.fix_zh: 换成真实信息
rules.fix_en: Replace with your real details

rules.zh: 电话没有国家区号, 或只有中国号码却没写客服时间/时区
rules.en: Phone lacks a country code, or a China number without service hours/time zone
rules.fix_zh: 写 +86 并注明客服时间 (换算成买家时区)
rules.fix_en: Add the country code and service hours in the buyer's time zone

rules.zh: 卖多个市场, 但没有国家/币种切换器
rules.en: Several markets but no country/currency selector
rules.fix_zh: 开启国家/币种选择器
rules.fix_en: Turn on the country/currency selector

rules.zh: 某市场版本的商品价格不是当地币种
rules.en: A market version does not price in local currency
rules.fix_zh: 在多国站点设置里开本币定价或自动换算
rules.fix_en: Enable local-currency pricing in the market settings

rules.zh: 多语言网址标注有错 (代码无效, 没有自引用或互相回指, 不是完整网址, 缺默认版本)
rules.en: Language/region URL annotations have errors (invalid code, missing self or return link, relative URL, no x-default)
rules.fix_zh: 用平台自动标注, 关掉重复的插件标注
rules.fix_en: Use the platform's automatic annotations and turn off duplicate app tags

rules.zh: 某市场版本的规范网址没有指向自己
rules.en: A market version's canonical URL does not point to itself
rules.fix_zh: 用平台默认设置, 不要用插件改规范网址
rules.fix_en: Keep the platform default canonical tags

rules.zh: 非英语市场页面有未翻译内容 (Translation missing 或大段英文)
rules.en: Non-English market pages have untranslated text (Translation missing or large English parts)
rules.fix_zh: 用翻译工具补全, 重点是商品页和政策
rules.fix_en: Complete the translation, product pages and policies first

rules.zh: 英文页面出现汉字 (多半是从供应商处搬来的描述)
rules.en: Chinese characters on English pages (usually copied supplier text)
rules.fix_zh: 删除或翻译
rules.fix_en: Remove or translate

rules.zh: 尺寸单位与市场习惯不符 (美国页只有 cm/kg, 或欧洲页只有 inch/lb)
rules.en: Units do not match the market (US pages only cm/kg, EU pages only inch/lb)
rules.fix_zh: 两种单位并列
rules.fix_en: Show both unit systems

rules.zh: 没说明关税与税费由谁付
rules.en: Does not say who pays duties and taxes
rules.fix_zh: 写清"价格已含税和关税"或"到货可能需缴关税, 由买家承担"
rules.fix_en: Say prices include duties, or that buyers may pay duties on delivery

rules.zh: 各市场看到的是同一份政策, 没按市场区分
rules.en: All markets see the same policy text
rules.fix_zh: 按市场分版本, 或统一写最严格的版本
rules.fix_en: Version policies by market or write the strictest one

rules.zh: 按访客地区自动跳转可能把搜索引擎也跳走 (只能提示)
rules.en: Geo-redirects may also redirect search engines (hint only)
rules.fix_zh: 不要对搜索引擎做强制跳转
rules.fix_en: Do not force-redirect crawlers

rules.zh: 页面有主题示例文字 (Lorem ipsum 等)
rules.en: Theme sample text on the page (Lorem ipsum etc.)
rules.fix_zh: 换成你的内容或删掉该区块
rules.fix_en: Replace with your content or remove the section

rules.zh: 有主题占位图
rules.en: Theme placeholder images
rules.fix_zh: 换真实图片
rules.fix_en: Use real images

rules.zh: 有测试商品 (标题含 test/demo/样品, 或价格 0/0.01)
rules.en: Test products (title with test/demo, or price 0/0.01)
rules.fix_zh: 删除或隐藏
rules.fix_en: Delete or hide them

rules.zh: 没有网站图标
rules.en: No favicon
rules.fix_zh: 上传网站图标
rules.fix_en: Upload a favicon

rules.zh: 店铺仍开着密码页 (已上线的店要撤掉)
rules.en: Store still behind the password page (remove it once live)
rules.fix_zh: 撤掉密码 (需先完成套餐与地址设置); 还没上线可忽略
rules.fix_en: Remove the password (needs a paid plan and address); ignore if not live yet

rules.zh: 店名仍是默认值, 版权年份过期, 或社媒图标指向平台首页/空链接
rules.en: Default store name, outdated copyright year, or social icons linking to platform homepages
rules.fix_zh: 改主题设置
rules.fix_en: Fix in theme settings

rules.zh: 搜索引擎抓取规则禁止抓取整站
rules.en: Crawler rules block the whole site
rules.fix_zh: 删除整站禁止规则
rules.fix_en: Remove the site-wide block

rules.zh: 首页设置了不让搜索引擎收录
rules.en: Homepage tells search engines not to index it
rules.fix_zh: 删除首页的不收录设置
rules.fix_en: Remove the no-index setting from the homepage

rules.zh: 网站地图打不开或不含商品
rules.en: Sitemap missing or without products
rules.fix_zh: Shopify 自动生成; 其他平台开插件
rules.fix_en: Shopify generates it; other platforms need a plugin
